secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.description: The Gmail address that sends the form emails, e.g. barkingbearpetcare@gmail.com (used as the SMTP login and From address).

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: A Gmail App Password (16 chars) for the sending account. Create one at myaccount.google.com > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords. Do NOT use your normal Gmail password.
